english.title: Obstruct a tunnel / tunnel access road at Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority or reasonable excuse,

(A)_[caused an obstruction in a tunnel]_
(B)_[restricted the use of tunnel access roads]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) within Heathrow Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 8.2(b) and 2.2 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
